evals.prompt: Create a new Card component for @pcln/horizon with size and emphasis variants
evals.expected_output: Component following horizon-standard anatomy with .tsx, .variants.ts, .stories.tsx, .spec.tsx, .testFixtures.tsx, and index.ts
expectations: Uses forwardRef with named function
Props extend ComponentVariants and ComponentPropsWithoutRef
All styling in .variants.ts using tv() from src/variants/tv
Exports VariantProps<typeof cardVariants> and typeof cardVariants.slots
Uses import type for type-only imports
JSDoc with @import tag as documentation source
Uses cn() for class merging and cleanProps() for DOM spread
Single export per main component file
Stories include desktop and mobile versions
testFixtures file created and shared between stories and specs

evals.prompt: I need to add a z-index to fix an overlay stacking issue in my Horizon component
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends alternatives before z-index and asks for developer permission if z-index is needed
expectations: Suggests isolate as preferred stacking context approach
Mentions pseudo-elements or composition as alternatives
States z-index requires justification and developer approval
Does NOT immediately add a z-index without discussion

evals.prompt: Write a Storybook story for an existing Horizon Badge component that uses container queries
evals.expected_output: JSX-based story with desktop and mobile variants using container query patterns
expectations: Uses JSX-based stories, NOT snapshotStoryDecorator
Includes both desktop and mobile stories
Mobile story uses container with w-[390px] arbitrary value
Uses react-docgen-typescript for args where possible
Hides children/node type props from Controls
Includes interaction tests with play functions
Imports test data from .testFixtures.tsx

evals.prompt: Audit the Button component against horizon-standard
evals.expected_output: Component audited against all 11 standards with visual verification
expectations: Checks all standards: anatomy, composition, styling, TS, a11y, storybook, tests, sonar, layout, package
Uses Storybook MCP to capture visuals before changes
Updates horizon-standard-audit.md with dated results
Writes audit report to .pcln-ai-output/horizon-standard/
Uses pass/warn/fail indicators per standard

evals.prompt: I'm building a component that needs to respond to different screen sizes. Should I use media queries or container queries?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends container queries as the default, explains when media queries are appropriate
expectations: Recommends container queries as the default choice
Mentions @container + @2xl breakpoints
Notes media queries are only for truly viewport-dependent cases like Hero
Does NOT default to media queries

evals.prompt: I'm working on a horizon-messaging component for email templates
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this is excluded from horizon-standard
expectations: Identifies that horizon-messaging uses react-email with different conventions
Does NOT apply horizon-standard rules
Suggests the horizon-messaging skill instead
